requirements.subject: multiple advance warning signs approaching a transition/activity area
requirements.relation: has ROAD WORK AHEAD (W20-1) as the first sign encountered by road users
requirements.threshold: W20-1 is first in approach order
applicability_conditions: multiple advance warning signs are used on the approach
required_inputs: identities and approach order of advance warning signs
requirements.source_span: Where multiple advance warning signs are needed on the approach to a transition and activity area, the ROAD WORK AHEAD (W20-1) sign should be the first advance warning sign encountered by road users.

requirements.candidate_label: Merging taper directs traffic to one lane
requirements.subject: merging taper for the closed left lane on the multilane roadway
requirements.relation: directs vehicular traffic into either the right-hand or left-hand lane, but not both
applicability_conditions: one lane is closed on a multilane road
the closure is not a mobile operation
required_inputs: observed taper path and receiving lane
requirements.source_span: The merging taper shall direct vehicular traffic into either the right-hand or left-hand lane, but not both.
